entities.summary: Tracy Shane Letts is an American actor, playwright, and screenwriter. He started his career acting at the Steppenwolf Theatre. He debuted as a playwright on Broadway with August: Osage County (2007), for which he received the Pulitzer Prize for Drama and the Tony Award for Best Play. As an actor, he won the Tony Award for Best Actor in a Play for the Broadway revival of Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf? (2013).
